expected_behavior_change: Admin HTML shell is always no-store/no-cache so normal Safari/browser sessions load the current deployed app without private mode or manual cache clearing.
Safari back-forward-cache restore reloads the Admin shell once instead of reviving stale code.
SMT keeps a passive WebSocket doorbell listener but does not self-pull on focus/pageshow/visibility changes.
Every Admin doorbell triggers one canonical pull; reconnect triggers one catch-up pull for missed doorbells.
SMT outbound projection sends immediately when new facts are enqueued, plus one startup/online backlog retry; no focus/config-change polling.
non_goals: No Order, Pricing, Payment, Print, Keeta, Customer, SMM or Owner semantic change.
No destructive cache clearing or localStorage reset.
No service worker introduced for Admin.
